name: Tsukude (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Tsukude village emblem in white: a ring open at the bottom enclosing a triangle with a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former village of Tsukude in Aichi Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-10-01.
